creator: bengusberg
title: Vercel's 'find-skills' skill: a meta-skill that searches skills.sh and auto-installs relevant agent skills

tools.name: skills.sh / npx skills CLI
tools.detail: 'The CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem. Supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 75 more'; commands 'npx skills find <query>' and 'npx skills add <package>'

claims: Install once; afterwards Claude automatically searches the web and installs whatever skills you need
Built-in bank of almost 1.5 million skills (transcript claim; not shown on screen)
how_to_steps: Copy the URL and paste it into Claude (or ChatGPT) and ask it to help you install
Afterwards, when you ask 'how do I X' Claude runs 'npx skills find <query>' and 'npx skills add <package>' to install matching skills
on_screen_only: Terminal header: '05/05  ~/.claude/skills/find-skills/  Find Skills. Installs new skills for you.'

Skill description text: 'Helps identify relevant skills by domain and task when users ask how do I X or find a skill for X. Provides npx skills find [query] command to search interactively and npx skills add <package> to install from GitHub or other sources. Recommends skills based on install count (prefer 1K+), source reputation (official sources like Vercel, Anthropic), and GitHub stars to ensure quality. Checks the default leaderboard first for battle-tested, popular options before running CLI searches.'
cta: Try it out and let me know what you build; follow for more on AI founder life

relevance.why: Directly relevant to a Claude Code power user: a discovery layer over the skills ecosystem reduces time spent hunting for skills. Vercel-backed and tied to the skills.sh registry.

implement_score.why: Cheap to try: one 'npx skills add vercel-labs/skills/find-skills' command. Caveat: auto-installing third-party skills is a supply-chain risk; review before trusting install-count rankings. The '1.5M skills' figure is almost certainly inflated.

verify: Confirm skills.sh and the vercel-labs/skills repo are real and maintained; check actual install counts vs the 3.6M claim
Does the skill auto-install without confirmation, or does it just recommend? (security: arbitrary SKILL.md from GitHub)
Does it work in Claude Code specifically, or mainly via the npx CLI?
'1.5 million skills' vs the on-screen 'prefer 1K+ installs' heuristic -- what is the real registry size?
